relations: Celia（叙述者）；Harriot；Roland（幻影/床伴）；包工头（前史）；adjunct（前史）
numbers: 与包工头三年（15–18 岁）；20 岁的 adjunct

facts.fact: 「我永远无法当面承认：嫉妒 Harriot」在 ch31（此处不重记）——本章开于浴室羞辱
facts.anchor: my senses returned to me, but it wasn’t a gift
facts.verbatim: my senses returned to me, but it wasn’t a gift

facts.fact: 浴室里如困鼠爪张、直到想起自己；羞辱比热水烧得凶
facts.anchor: Humiliation burned worse than the hot water.
facts.verbatim: Humiliation burned worse than the hot water.

facts.fact: 她满是新断层；若被用这知识逗弄将永远碎裂；控制不了对方拿这权力做什么
从没信鬼——但你的冷指与 Harriot 的一样真实；也许永远解不开真相
facts.anchor: I might never untwist the truth.
facts.verbatim: I might never untwist the truth.

facts.fact: Harriot 在图书馆望窗（毯滑裸肩、颈侧吻痕）；她溜进办公室换备用衣
facts.anchor: a love bite dark on the side of her neck
facts.verbatim: a love bite dark on the side of her neck

facts.fact: Harriot 盘腿坐旧收音机前吃面；「想弄清今天星期几」；KTHS：雪、周四成冰
facts.anchor: Trying to figure out what day it is
facts.verbatim: Trying to figure out what day it is

facts.fact: 「今天星期二」「我们周六下的谷」；沉默沉重
facts.anchor: We went down into the valley Saturday morning.
facts.verbatim: We went down into the valley Saturday morning.

facts.fact: 她抢先撒谎：「我什么都不记得。我们被下药了」；Harriot 评估眼后「当然」
facts.anchor: We were drugged and that’s all there is to it.
facts.verbatim: We were drugged and that’s all there is to it.

facts.fact: Harriot 拿出散页（两面密写）；「醒过来时我已写了这些」——声音微抖：不倒的 Joan Harriot 慌了
她读段：「她软化之肉的病甜…鲜奶浮起的奶油球…她的身体在凝结」
「我不懂」「不记得写」；「你说过你不信鬼，对吧？」——她呼吸太快：你也来找她，带灵感与声灵
facts.anchor: With inspiration, with the gift of your voice
facts.verbatim: With inspiration, with the gift of your voice

facts.fact: 「这是发生在我们两个身上的事」；她轻轻夺回手稿；「休息一下」；泪涌——怜悯比恨更坏
facts.anchor: her pity, scratching all my bleeding places, was worse.
facts.verbatim: her pity, scratching all my bleeding places, was worse.
